_comment: PA3 evaluation set: six corpus-covered medical questions and three diagnostic failure cases. The first six topics are supported by PA2 retrieval runs or extracted corpus samples.

queries.label: good_1_blood_pressure
queries.query: Kateri so simptomi visokega krvnega tlaka in zakaj je merjenje pomembno?
queries.expected_evidence: Articles about hypertension symptoms, risks and blood-pressure monitoring.
queries.coverage_basis: PA2 reranked run retrieved a directly relevant blood-pressure management article.

queries.label: good_2_diabetes_lifestyle
queries.query: Kako zdrav življenjski slog pomaga pri sladkorni bolezni tipa 2?
queries.expected_evidence: Articles about type 2 diabetes, diet, activity and glucose management.
queries.coverage_basis: PA2 reranked run retrieved the cardiometabolic factors article.

queries.label: good_3_sleep
queries.query: Kako izboljšati spanec in zakaj je reden spanec pomemben?
queries.coverage_basis: PA2 query evaluation and extracted validation articles contain sleep-focused content.

queries.label: good_4_parkinson
queries.query: Kateri so značilni simptomi Parkinsonove bolezni in kako pomaga gibanje?
queries.expected_evidence: Article about Parkinson disease symptoms and physical activity.
queries.coverage_basis: Extracted PA2 corpus sample contains a Parkinson disease article with both topics.

queries.label: good_5_vitamin_b12
queries.query: Kateri znaki lahko kažejo na pomanjkanje vitamina B12?
queries.expected_evidence: Article about vitamin B12 symptoms, risk groups and food sources.
queries.coverage_basis: Extracted PA2 corpus sample contains a vitamin B12 article.

queries.label: good_6_protein
queries.query: Zakaj so beljakovine pomembne pri ohranjanju mišične mase?
queries.expected_evidence: Nutrition articles discussing protein and muscle preservation.
queries.coverage_basis: A PA2 reranking run for 'proteini' retrieved relevant muscle-loss and protein segments.

queries.label: bad_1_ambiguous_pain
queries.expected_evidence: Ambiguous matches about unrelated types of pain.

queries.label: bad_2_out_of_domain_legal
queries.query: Kakšne so pravne posledice neplačila prometne kazni v Sloveniji?
queries.expected_evidence: No relevant medical-corpus evidence; the RAG answer should decline to infer a legal answer.

queries.label: bad_3_acronym_no_context
queries.expected_evidence: No reliable evidence because the acronym is underspecified.
queries.coverage_basis: Retained PA2 acronym ambiguity failure case.
